tasks.subject: Task 2: KEYSTONE — delta-sourced entity + field provenance builder (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add build_entity_provenance_from_delta_graph reading context._delta_merged_graph nodes (where Task 1's stamp lands), emit per-entity ExtractionProvenance AND per-field ExtractionFieldProvenance with positional lists; wire into main.py BEFORE build_provenance_from_context/synth AND gate build_auto_field_evidence to fallback-only. Add schema list fields; demote _resolve_element_uid.

**WHY (verified blocker):** build_provenance_from_context reads knowledge_graph (provenance-stripped) → [] in prod → coarse chunk-0 synth. Task 1's stamp lands on _delta_merged_graph, which NO entity builder reads.

**Files:** Modify docker/docling-graph/app/schemas.py; docker/docling-graph/app/provenance.py (NEW builder + demote _resolve_element_uid); docker/docling-graph/app/main.py (new builder first ~1700-1730; gate build_auto_field_evidence fallback-only ~1928); Create docker/docling-graph/tests/test_entity_provenance_from_delta.py; Modify docker/docling-graph/tests/test_resolve_element_uid_prefers_evidence.py (INVERT 2 tests); Modify scripts/run_tests.sh.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- ExtractionProvenance + ExtractionFieldProvenance gain list fields; element_uid=self_refs[0].
- builder per entity: ontology_name from model_config[ontology_name] via path→model (NOT node_type=class name — drops every row); identity_values from node[ids]; positional self_refs/chunk_indexes/page_numbers/cited_refs; element_uid=self_refs[0]; SCALAR page=page_numbers[0] (REQUIRED — gate rejects page=None → recall collapse). Field rows per property_evidence with positional self_refs.
- FIELD RECONCILIATION: gate build_auto_field_evidence (main.py:1928) fallback-only (no duplicate field rows).
- main.py calls new builder FIRST, fallback if []; logs which fired.
- _resolve_element_uid demoted to self_refs[0]; INVERT BOTH contradicting tests.
- Unit test: node A self_refs=[#/texts/3,#/texts/4] page_numbers=[19,20] cited_refs=[#/texts/3] ids={system_name:SNR-75} → ExtractionProvenance both self_refs, cited_refs=[#/texts/3], element_uid=#/texts/3, SCALAR page=19, ontology_name=RADAR_SYSTEM (not class), identity_values={system_name:SNR-75}, + ExtractionFieldProvenance positional.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest docker/docling-graph/tests/test_entity_provenance_from_delta.py docker/docling-graph/tests/test_resolve_element_uid_prefers_evidence.py -v

tasks.subject: Task 5: Field chunk_id resolution + relationship source-chunk edge props (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Field evidence rows get RESOLVED chunk_id (not None) IN THE MERGE PHASE; committed relationship edges carry source_chunk_ids/source_pages/source_self_refs via record.properties (no RID round-trip) resolved from rel positional self_refs.

**Files:** Modify app/workers/pipeline.py (resolve _field_evidence chunk_id in _import_graph_phase_nodes ~1300-1318 via _load_identity_map + merge-phase element_uid_chunk_map; rel self_refs→record.properties ~1510); Modify app/services/arcadedb_schema.py (~140 _COMMON_EDGE_PROPS, 3 LIST props; NO upsert SQL change); Create tests/unit/test_field_and_rel_lineage.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- FIELD (PHASE CONSTRAINT verified): _field_evidence serialized at _import_graph_phase_nodes (1303, MERGE phase) but identity_map + element_uid_chunk_map built only in derive_structure_links (9296+, separate task) — NOT in scope at 1303. Resolve at merge phase: _load_identity_map(document_id) + one-shot element_uid_chunk_map (query shape 9256-9270), resolve each row element_uid→chunk_id before serialize. chunk_id==C not None; page retained.
- Rel: worker resolves positional self_refs (on RelationshipRecord.provenance, pre-existing via delta) → record.properties[source_chunk_ids/source_pages/source_self_refs]; upsert writes both branches. No RID round-trip.
- _COMMON_EDGE_PROPS registers 3 LIST props (additive).
- Unit tests: (a) maps resolving #/texts/3→C → field row element_uid=#/texts/3 gets chunk_id==C; (b) RelationshipRecord self_refs=[#/texts/3] → record.properties[source_chunk_ids] contains C (assert on record, no live DB).

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_field_and_rel_lineage.py -v

tasks.subject: Task 6: Deploy + all-three-targets precise-lineage gate end-to-end (USER-ORDERED)
tasks.description:

**Files:** Modify scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Deploy: 0001-0006 applied green; up -d --force-recreate docling-graph; BOTH workers restarted; all 3 StartedAt advanced; container ir_normalizer.py shows cited_refs + provenance.py shows build_entity_provenance_from_delta_graph; pool idle.
- Entity precision (run-scoped): per-entity EXTRACTED_FROM ≤ batch width (≈1), NOT ~all; K-distribution; FAIL if any ≥50% doc chunks.
- Field precision: _field_evidence chunk_id resolved (0 hardcoded None).
- Relationship precision: edges carry source_chunk_ids within batch set.
- Per-target recall: entity vs audit merged; field vs property-evidence; rel vs post-validation accepted (rejected separate).
- Run-scoped + EXTRACTED_FROM-only trace + fail-closed.
- ALL CHECKS PASS.
